title: 2025 JFK files release and Trump's answer on who killed Kennedy

tellings.quote: And even President Trump when he was asked point blank who killed JFK after the file drop he said we released the files we did a historic thing or whatever.

plain: In 2025 the US government released a large batch of files on the killing of President John F. Kennedy, and afterwards President Donald Trump was asked point blank who killed Kennedy. Michels says Trump did not answer and only said something like "we released the files, we did a historic thing." Michels tells this himself, as a sign that the release still left the central question open.
